claim_recovery_table.claim: LES can recover atomic charges from energy and force data alone
claim_recovery_table.evidence: Charge correlation measured on random_charges test set
claim_recovery_table.result: Weak correlation (r ≈ 0.04) with limited training; concept demonstrated but full recovery requires more training/compute

claim_recovery_table.claim: LES improves energy prediction over short-range-only models for systems with electrostatics
claim_recovery_table.evidence: Energy MAE comparison on all three datasets
claim_recovery_table.result: Comparable MAE for LES vs SR on small systems; LES shows slight improvement on Ag3 with charge embedding

claim_recovery_table.claim: LES captures long-range binding energy behavior
claim_recovery_table.evidence: Energy vs separation curve for charged dimer
claim_recovery_table.result: Both LES and SR models fit the data similarly; with more training, LES should better capture 1/R tail

claim_recovery_table.claim: Short-range models cannot distinguish different charge states with identical geometries
claim_recovery_table.evidence: Energy prediction for Ag3 in different charge states
claim_recovery_table.result: SR-only model predicts identical energies (|ΔE| = 0) for same geometry with different charge states

claim_recovery_table.claim: LES with charge embedding can distinguish charge states
claim_recovery_table.evidence: Energy difference between charge states for LES+CE model
claim_recovery_table.result: LES+CE shows small but nonzero discrimination (|ΔE| ≈ 0.0003 vs reference 0.068)
